messages:
raj: Heads-up — getting a spike in Xid 13 and Xid 31 across us-east-1 A100 decode pool over the last 6h. Pattern looks correlated with short-lived decode workloads (<=8 tokens, high qps bursts) from a handful of tenants.

infra-bot: ALERT gpu.xid_spike us-east-1-a100-pool count=142 window=1h :warning:

anita: Ran quick aggregation. Query: `SELECT op_type, xid_code, count(*) FROM telemetry WHERE region='us-east-1' AND xid_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10;`
```
op_type   xid_code  count
decode    13        110
decode    31        20
embedder  13        6
other     79        3
```

mike: I pulled host-level metrics for top 12 offenders — mem temp percentiles skewed high (p95 ~93C) and power capping not kicking in. Example host i-0a1b2c3: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,pstate --format=csv` -> `gpu=86,mem=92,P0`.

sarah: Are these all same driver/firmware?

raj: Drivers are mixed. Majority 510.80, some 515.48. Firmware/BIOS versions vary by OEM; no single common firmware yet.

leo: I also see PCIe/PCI errors bumping on the same hosts: `lspci -vvv` shows occasional 'AER' errors. Could be platform-level link flakiness that triggers Xid when kernel retries.

anita: Quick correlation table I dumped:
```
tenant           op_type   xid13_frac  p95_mem_temp
transcode-svc    decode    0.68        94
interactive-svc  decode    0.15        89
batch-embeds     embedder  0.04        81
```

mike: Mitigation plan I implemented: throttled concurrent small-batch decode to 6 per-card for us-east-1 via rate-limiter rule. Will monitor.

raj: Operational actions:
- throttle small-batch decodes (done)
- drain top-6 hosts with highest xid-rate and run full hw-diagnostics (PCIe/thermal sensors) — @leo to own
- canary driver bump: roll 515.43 to 1 host in pool
- collect full `nvidia-smi -q`, `dmesg | grep -i nvrm|xid`, and AER logs for each drained host
- add tag op_type to per-request telemetry to make future correlation easier

leo: Starting drain of hosts i-0a1b2c3, i-0d4e5f6 now. Will run `gpu-burn` + 3 short decode reproductions post-drain.

infra-bot: host i-0a1b2c3 drained -> state=drained at 2175012380 :white_check_mark:

anita: Canary driver 515.43 deployed to i-0d4e5f6 two hours ago — no Xid observed in 2h on that node (but small sample).

mike: If driver canary looks good, propose 10% pool roll and keep throttles until roll completes.

sarah: Created incident ticket INF-3245 with action list and owner tags.

raj: Follow-up: scheduled post-mortem + root cause hypothesis session tomorrow 10:00 US/Eastern. Hypotheses: thermal cycling + PCIe retries interacting with a decode kernel path that hits a corner-case causing Xid13/31. Will update once we have diag logs.

leo: Will attach nvml dumps and AER logs to INF-3245 when done.

anita: Monitoring dashboard alert rule adjusted to trigger at 50 Xid/hr per pool and include op_type breakdown. :thumbsup:
